{{Quote|Time now for ''Life on Tatooine,'' brought to viewers everywhere in the hope that our own lives may be uplifted by the comparison and enriched with the gratitude of relief. This transmission is unrehearsed and unedited, and is hereby begun without further comment as to its lack of moral value.|Announcer, ''Life on Tatooine''|<ref name="SWHS">''[[The Star Wars Holiday Special]]''.</ref>}}
[[File:Life_on_Tatooine.png|thumb|250px|Introductory shot of ''Life on Tatooine'']]
'''''Life on Tatooine''''' was a [[holodocumentary]]<ref name="SWHS" /> that aired in [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]].<ref name="date">{{SWBoards|url=thread.jspa?threadID=152583&start=870#15778940|thread=Holocron continuity database questions|user=[[Leland Chee|Tasty Taste]]|date=2006-10-12|time=6:13 PM}}</ref> The film was broadcast on orders of the [[Imperial Ruling Council/Legends|Imperial Council]], who felt that it would improve the loyalty to the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] of those who viewed it. Imperial forces were ordered to watch it.<ref name="SWHS" />

The film consisted of live, unedited footage of [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. Various shots showed citizens of the [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] going about their daily lives. The holodocumentary also caught visitors to the town, such as [[Bimm/Legends|Bimm]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Rycar Ryjerd/Legends|Rycar Ryjerd]] running from Imperial [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] and being scared by a stilt-legged creature.<ref name="SWHS" />

The film's longest segment took place in [[Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina/Legends|Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina]], where the bartender [[Ackmena/Legends|Ackmena]] was on duty. As the footage aired, the Empire ordered a curfew, forcing the cantina patrons to head home prematurely. The crowd grew unruly, but Ackmena managed to sway them to leave with her rendition of "[[Goodnight, But Not Goodbye/Legends|Goodnight, But Not Goodbye]]," accompanied by the cantina band, [[Figrin D'an and the Modal Nodes/Legends|Figrin D'an and the Modal Nodes]].<ref name="SWHS" />
